channel.title: @jitendravjh
channel.description: Jitendra Verma - a software developer building mobile and web apps with Flutter, Swift, and modern web tech.

item.title: Adding a Map Projection, and Getting It Reviewed
item.description: Implementing the Stereographic projection for CoordRefSystems.jl from Snyder and PROJ, then a review conversation about which parameter a projection should actually be typed on.

item.title: The Kepler Conjecture
item.description: No arrangement of equal spheres fills more than π/√18 of space. Kepler asserted it in 1611 without argument; it took until 1998 to prove and 2014 to check by machine.

item.title: The Jacobian Conjecture in Dimension Three
item.description: A conjecture open since 1939 was refuted in July 2026, for three variables and above. A Pluto notebook that verifies the counterexample in exact arithmetic and accounts for how it works.

item.title: Three Geometry Bugs in Meshes.jl
item.description: A polygon that meshed to NaN, a grid query that always came back empty, and an intersection that recursed until the stack ran out. Three fixes in JuliaGeometry/Meshes.jl.

item.title: The Largest Empty Circle
item.description: Finding the point in Australia farthest from any town by reducing an optimisation over the plane to a search over Voronoi vertices.

item.title: Four Bugs Hiding Behind a Skip List
item.description: Round-trip testing every map projection in CoordRefSystems.jl over the whole globe, and what the blanket skips in the test suite were quietly covering up.

item.title: No IP Address to Type: mDNS Discovery and a TURN Fallback
item.description: Making a self-hosted app connect with zero configuration - advertising a server over mDNS, falling back to a public one, and relaying through TURN when peers are on different networks.

item.title: Building Synq: WebRTC Calling in Flutter, from 1:1 to Mesh
item.description: How I built real-time video calling in Flutter - a sealed signalling protocol, a call state machine that avoids glare, and a mesh that scales the same code to a group.

item.title: Bringing Dark Mode to TuringLang Docs
item.description: Adding a theme switcher with auto-detection to TuringLang's documentation - the no-flash trick, system preference, and remembering the user's choice.

item.title: Building SecureVault: AES-256 and Native Platform Channels in Flutter
item.description: How I built a privacy vault that disguises itself as ordinary utility apps - with real AES-256 encryption, a panic password, and native tricks like dynamic app-icon switching.

item.title: Adaptive Loss Functions for PINNs: My NeuralPDE.jl Contribution
item.description: Contributing SoftAdapt and ReLoBRaLo adaptive loss weighting to SciML/NeuralPDE.jl - and what adaptive weighting actually does for physics-informed neural networks.
